notes.title: D.O.T Demo Patch v1.0.0
notes.notes:
Changelogs (2025-06-06):

Moved the specific end-of-credit demo message to a popup window instead of the level_credit scene.

Fixed resolution option accidentally hidden on prod

Fixed executable file metadata version (displaying 0.7.0 instead of 1.0.0)



Known issues:

End-of-credit demo message text may extend beyond popup window in some languages (popup window can be resized by user)
